_definitions.all_correct_unrated: Design A pool (>= 200 rated answers) students whose rated answers are all correct; their answers without a rating
_definitions.strand_other_S1: share of all S1 answers whose question carries more than one level-1 strand (combined), one level-1 strand outside the four main strands (minor), or none
_definitions.ipw_change: IPW minus unweighted Spearman-Brown reliability, Design B pool N = 20, on the subsample of confound_selection.py (seed [42, 81, sid])
_definitions.mc_se_max: maximum Monte Carlo SE of the mean over 50 splits
_definitions.level_ranges: min and max of answer-level mean bias across the four main strands (or terms), all rated answers
